ApplicationParameterTemplate.extra: Whether there are additional modifications (0: none; 1: yes). Parameters without modifications do not need to be passed
ApplicationParameterTemplate.cacheClusterList.region: Region where the instance is located
ApplicationParameterTemplate.rebootType: Whether a reboot is required (0: no reboot; 1: reboot during maintenance window; 2: reboot immediately. The primary cluster of a hot-active setup cannot be rebooted)
ApplicationParameterTemplate.parameters: Parameters to be modified in the parameter template, valid when extra=1
ApplicationParameterTemplate.parameters.confName: Parameter name (refer to the system template)
ApplicationParameterTemplate.parameters.confValue: Parameter value (modify the corresponding value within the allowed range specified in confRange, refer to the system template)
ApplicationParameterTemplate.parameters.confType: Parameter type (refer to the system template)
